versions.source: AJCC Cancer Staging Manual 8th Edition / NCCN / UICC
versions.provenance: 8th edition staging, verified against AJCC 8th edition / NCCN guidelines; licensed verification standard. Requires R1 clinical verification before unchecked use.
versions.introduction: Cutaneous SCC of the head and neck is staged with 8th-edition criteria that add high-risk features to size: tumours 2 cm and 4 cm are the T1/T2/T3 size cutoffs, but minor bone erosion, perineural invasion of nerves 0.1 mm or larger in calibre, and deep invasion beyond subcutaneous fat or thicker than 6 mm each upstage to T3 regardless of size. Gross cortical or marrow invasion is T4a; skull-base or axial-skeleton invasion is T4b. Trunk/extremity SCC uses the same T with parotid nodes replaced by the draining basin. The Brigham and Women (BWH) alternative (risk factors: size 2 cm+, poor differentiation, perineural invasion 0.1 mm+, invasion beyond fat) predicts nodal metastasis and is recorded alongside. Nodal staging uses extranodal extension (ENE).

t.label: Tumour smaller than 2 cm in greatest dimension
Tumour 2 cm or larger up to 4 cm in greatest dimension
Tumour 4 cm or larger, or any tumour with minor bone erosion, perineural invasion of a nerve 0.1 mm or larger, or deep invasion beyond subcutaneous fat or thicker than 6 mm
Tumour with gross cortical bone or marrow invasion
Tumour with skull-base invasion and/or skull-base foramen involvement, or axial skeleton invasion

n.label: Regional lymph nodes cannot be assessed
Single ipsilateral node 3 cm or smaller, extranodal extension negative (ENE-)
Single ipsilateral node larger than 3 cm up to 6 cm, ENE-
Multiple ipsilateral nodes 6 cm or smaller, ENE-
Bilateral or contralateral nodes 6 cm or smaller, ENE-
Any node larger than 6 cm, ENE-
Any node with clinically overt extranodal extension (ENE+)

versions.regionalNodes: Head/neck: parotid (intra- and periparotid), submandibular, submental and upper jugular nodes. Trunk/extremity: the draining axillary, inguinal or epitrochlear basin. Bilateral or contralateral nodes upstage to N2c.
versions.histologicGrade: Well differentiated (G1), moderately differentiated (G2), poorly differentiated (G3), including desmoplastic and spindle-cell patterns. Poor differentiation is a BWH high-risk factor alongside size, perineural invasion and deep invasion.
versions.histopathologicTypes: Conventional cutaneous SCC; keratoacanthoma-like (low risk); desmoplastic, spindle-cell and adenosquamous variants (high risk); SCC arising in chronic ulcer, scar (Marjolin), discoid lupus or epidermolysis bullosa (aggressive).
prognosticFactors: Tumour diameter (2 cm and 4 cm cutoffs)
Deep invasion beyond fat or over 6 mm thick
Perineural invasion of nerves 0.1 mm or larger
BWH risk-factor count (T2b with 2-3 factors behaves aggressively)
